additional_info.subject: RE: ID0423035-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/19]CHARGER FAIL SAFE MODE CRM:02681000148
additional_info.body:
Dear RC-FR Team,
Upon reviewing the logs, it appears that there may be an issue with a corrupted CFAST card. The error message
"Accept returns: Too many open files"
suggests a possible problem with the firmware on the CFAST card. Further analysis indicates that the Linux image on the card may be corrupted, which could be causing the reported behavior.
To resolve this issue, we recommend reflashing the CFAST card. For detailed instructions, please refer to the KA linked below.
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SID_SW_CFASTcard_Too many open files - Dynamics 365
I am also attaching the configuration file for this charger. Please refer to the KA on
Live Linux Restore using a config USB
, and plan to proceed with the CFAST card flashing accordingly.
KA Link:
Knowledge Article: Knowledge Article for ISP: Emobility_SICD_SW_CfastCard_Corupted - Dynamics 365
